.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; max-width:1920px; margin:0 auto; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:Pretendard, sans-serif;}
.evWrap p, .evWrap ul, .evWrap li, .evWrap h3 {margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}
._pick ._tit {left:0; width:100%; font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:60px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.2px; line-height:80px; text-align:center; color:#214C67;}
._pick ._deco {font-family:'Cormorant', serif; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0; line-height:normal; color:#3E4F5B; opacity:0.5; white-space:nowrap;}

._pick ._tag ._pill {display:flex; align-items:center; height:41px; padding:10.8px 18px; border-radius:54px; font-size:16.2px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.49px; line-height:normal; white-space:nowrap;}
._pick ._tag ._ico {display:flex; flex:0 0 auto; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:43px; height:43px; border-radius:50%;}
._pick ._tag ._name {font-size:20.7px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-0.62px; line-height:normal; white-space:nowrap; text-align:center; color:#fff;}
._best ._tit {font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:60px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.8px; line-height:80px; text-align:center; color:#214C67;}
._best ._cate_tit {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; height:48px; font-size:40px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-1.2px; line-height:48px; color:#161616;}
._best ._item ._thumb {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:231px; height:231px; background-color:#E5E5E5; overflow:hidden;}

._best ._item ._desc {display:-webkit-box; min-height:36px; margin-top:10px; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:18px; letter-spacing:0;}

._event ._gift ._box ._badge {position:absolute; left:15px; top:15px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:76px; height:76px; border-radius:50%; background-color:#DD153E; font-family:Avenir, Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:400; line-height:18px; letter-spacing:-0.16px; text-align:center; color:#fff;}

._event ._more {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:431px; width:fit-content; height:50px; margin:62px auto 0; padding:0 30px; background-color:#05446D; font-size:18px; font-weight:600; line-height:normal; letter-spacing:0; color:#fff;}
